title: Add descriptor backend probe invalidation
summary: Add generic descriptor backend probe invalidation and delegate legacy NVENC invalidation through it while preserving the existing NVENC cache surface used by Do-Encode.
reason: Phase 6 hardware activation needs backend-neutral fail-closed capability-probe cache behavior before QSV, AMF, or AV1/NVENC paths can be safely enabled.
behavior_before: Descriptor capability probes had per-descriptor list/runtime cache entries, but runtime invalidation existed only as the legacy $script:NvencAvailableProbe path and did not provide backend-neutral invalidation or additive backend event evidence.
behavior_after: Invalidate-EncoderBackendProbe records backend-level descriptor probe invalidation, removes matching descriptor cache entries, returns fail-closed invalidated probe results, emits gpu_unavailable events with backend evidence, and is used by Invalidate-NvencAvailableProbe for the NVENC backend.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser check for encoder_descriptors.ps1, encode_policy.ps1, and Invoke-EncoderCapabilityProbeChecks.ps1 - passed
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncoderRuntimeMatrixChecks.ps1 - passed (3 CPU rows executed, 9 hardware rows list-only skipped by default)
rollback_plan: Revert Invalidate-EncoderBackendProbe and Test-MediaEncoderDescriptorAvailable invalidation checks, restore Invalidate-NvencAvailableProbe to local-only invalidation, remove backend invalidation assertions, revert active-doc wording, and refresh generated summaries.
